name: Natsu no Torikago
source:
Aki is invited by his female friend Mayu to the camp in the mountains. Eiji suggests seeking a buried treasure. Young people find fireworks and spend a pleasant evening. When sun sets, heavy rain begins, and friends start to look for a shelter.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
秋被女性朋友真由邀请去山上露营。英二提议寻找埋藏的宝藏。年轻人们发现了烟花，度过了一个愉快的夜晚。日落时分，大雨开始下起，朋友们开始寻找避雨的地方。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
